description: Split ANY image into independent layers with Seedream (billed per OUTPUT layer incl. base). tier="pro" (default): Seedream 5.0 Pro, 7 cr @1K, 14 @2K, so a 3-layer split ≈ 21 cr. tier="flash": 3.24 cr/layer at any size, so ≈ 10 cr. tier="5.5" (NEW Nov 2026): Seedream 5.5, 3.6 cr/layer @1K/1.5K, 6.3 @2K or auto, + 1.44 cr for the input — with max_images to cap the layer count and optional text recognition. Works on any public image URL (upload local files with upload_file first). Describe which elements become layers in the prompt, optionally bounding them with <bbox>x1 y1 x2 y2</bbox> tags. Downloads every layer image to kie/assets/raw/.

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

filename.description: Base output filename; layers get -2, -3... suffixes

image_url.description: Public URL of the source image (singular — one image per call)

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

max_images.description: tier "5.5" only: maximum output images INCLUDING the base (2-100, kie default 30). The cheapest way to cap the bill.

prompt.description: Which elements to separate into layers, e.g. "Separate the title text <bbox>179 58 809 197</bbox> and the parrot <bbox>330 274 641 991</bbox> into independent layers"

size.description: auto, 1K, 1.5K or 2K. Pro: 7 cr/layer at 1K/1.5K, 14 at 2K. Flash: 3.24 at any size. 5.5: 3.6 at 1K/1.5K, 6.3 at 2K — and auto is billed at the 2K rate.

text_recognition.description: tier "5.5" only: recognize text in the layers (default false)

tier.description: pro = Seedream 5.0 Pro (7 cr/layer @1K, 14 @2K; prompt required). flash = Seedream 5.0 Flash (3.24 cr/layer at any size; prompt optional — but WITHOUT a prompt it splits out every element: a poster gave 12 layers = 38.9 cr. Name the elements you want to cap the layer count). 5.5 = Seedream 5.5 (NEW: 3.6 cr/layer @1K/1.5K, 6.3 @2K/auto, + 1.44 cr input image; prompt optional, ≤2000 chars; supports max_images and text_recognition).

name: seedream_layer_decompose
